input_requirement: The system shall generate a report at the end of each day.

ambiguities.fragment: at the end of each day
ambiguities.explanation: The phrase 'at the end of each day' has a fuzzy extension: there is no objectively measurable boundary defining exactly when 'the end' occurs (e.g., is it 23:59:59, midnight, or the moment the business day closes?). At least one specific timestamp exists for which it is impossible to determine whether the report generation satisfies the requirement.
possible_interpretations: The report must be generated at the precise moment of midnight (00:00:00) marking the transition to the next day.
The report must be generated at the moment the business operations cease, which could be 23:59:59 or any time shortly before midnight.

ambiguity_resolubility.fragment: at the end of each day
ambiguity_resolubility.supported_interpretation: The report must be generated at 23:59:59 UTC on the calendar day.
evidence_from_context: Business rule BR-01: 'For reporting purposes, end of day is defined as 23:59:59 UTC on the calendar day.'
ambiguity_resolubility.justification: The business rule explicitly defines 'end of day' as 23:59:59 UTC, eliminating the ambiguity regarding whether it refers to midnight or an unspecified time shortly before midnight.

structured_requirements.final_statement: The system shall generate a report at 23:59:59 UTC on the calendar day.
structuring_notes: AMB-01 resolved: fragment 'at the end of each day' replaced with 'at 23:59:59 UTC on the calendar day' per supported interpretation.
